Tests that Range read-only methods and Selection.containsNode() are side-effect-free.
Expression `window.getSelection().containsNode(connectedText, true)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `range.cloneRange().getBoundingClientRect()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `range.getClientRects()`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `range.intersectsNode(div)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `range.isPointInRange(connectedText, 0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `range.comparePoint(connectedText, 0)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `range.compareBoundaryPoints(Range.START_TO_START, range)`
has side effect: false, expected: false
Expression `window.getSelection().getRangeAt(0)`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `window.getSelection().getComposedRanges()`
has side effect: true, expected: true
Expression `range.collapse(true)`
has side effect: true, expected: true
